test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.

They said, "We were planning to visit you next week."

options.text: They said that they have been planning to visit him next week.
They said that they had planned to visit him next week.
They said that they had been planning to visit him the following week.
They said that they are planning to visit him the coming week.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** They said that they had been planning to visit him the following week.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **Pronoun Change:** "We" becomes "they" and "you" becomes "him."
 
• **Tense Change:** "were planning" becomes "had been planning" to reflect past continuous tense.
 
• **Time Change:** "next week" becomes "the following week."
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Direct speech is converted to indirect speech.
 
• Quotation marks are removed.
 
• Appropriate tense and pronoun changes are made.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *They said that they had been planning to visit him the following week.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** They said that they have been planning to visit him next week.

 
 
• Incorrect tense "have been planning" does not match the past tense context.
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** They said that they had planned to visit him next week.
 
 
• Incorrect tense "had planned" changes the meaning to a completed action rather than ongoing planning.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** They said that they are planning to visit him the coming week.
 
 
• Incorrect tense "are planning" does not match the past tense context.
